9001.title: Bulk reassign leads when a rep leaves
9001.body: When a rep leaves, a manager has to open each of their leads to change the owner. Let managers select many leads and reassign them in one step.

9002.title: Lead import stops at 5,000 rows
9002.body: Importing a CSV with more than 5,000 leads finishes without an error, but only the first 5,000 leads appear.

9003.title: Rebuild the search index nightly
9003.body: Search results drift out of date after bulk edits. Rebuild the search index each night so results match the database.

9004.title: Show open deals on the account page
9004.body: Account pages list contacts but not the account's open deals. Add a section listing each open deal with its stage and amount.

9005.title: Merging contacts keeps the older phone number
9005.body: When two duplicate contacts are merged, the surviving record keeps the older phone number even when the other record was updated more recently.

9006.title: Move account timeline events into their own table
9006.body: The account timeline query scans the whole activity table and takes several seconds on large accounts. Store timeline events in a table of their own.

9007.title: Admins can rename pipeline stages
9007.body: Customer admins want their own stage names (for example Discovery instead of Qualify), set in settings, without losing any deal's stage history.

9008.title: Dragging a deal to a new stage sometimes doesn't save
9008.body: On the pipeline board, a deal dragged to another column snaps back after a page refresh about one time in ten.

9009.title: Backfill stage history for older deals
9009.body: Deals created before stage history was recorded have no history rows. Write a one-off job that fills them in from the record-change audit log.

9010.title: Forecast shows last quarter's quota after the quarter rolls over
9010.body: On the first days of a new quarter, the forecast page still compares reps against the previous quarter's quota until someone edits a deal.

9011.title: Managers can override a rep's forecast category
9011.body: Managers want to move a deal between Commit, Best case and Pipeline in their own roll-up without changing the rep's call, with both numbers shown.

9012.title: Cache weighted forecast totals
9012.body: The forecast page recalculates every open deal on each load. Keep the totals and refresh them only when a deal changes.

9013.title: Rate-limit the public API per customer
9013.body: One customer's script can slow the API down for everyone. Limit each customer to a set number of API requests per minute.

9014.title: Admins connect calendars for the whole team
9014.body: Let a customer admin connect Google or Microsoft calendars for all of their reps at once from settings, instead of each rep doing it.

9015.title: Retry failed webhook deliveries
9015.body: If a customer's endpoint is down, webhook events are lost. Retry failed deliveries with a growing delay for up to 24 hours.

9016.title: Admins can require SSO for everyone
9016.body: Customer admins want a setting that forces every user in their workspace to sign in through SSO instead of a password.

9017.title: Invoices count one more seat than there are active users
9017.body: Monthly invoices charge for one seat more than the number of active users shown on the billing page.

9018.title: Rotate the key that signs session tokens
9018.body: Session tokens are signed with a key that has never been changed. Add a way to rotate it without signing everyone out.

9019.title: Show each PR's risk tier on its delivery board card
9019.body: Delivery board cards show a PR's number and title but not its tier. Add the tier so engineers can see it at a glance.

9020.title: Keep a daily total of agent token use
9020.body: Keep a running daily total of the tokens each agent uses, so cost can be reported without scanning the whole audit table.
